summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when the reference equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering Namespace prefix membership (positive and negative), RDFS closed membership (defined term, undefined term sharing the base, plain string and Literal with a defined term's text), and RDF closed membership (rdf:type). Nothing was committed. Tests and doctests were not run, per the instruction not to execute repository code, so they are unverified.
